correctness.rationale: For all labelled m>=3,n>=6, a dissociation set in C_m Cartesian K_n has <=2 chosen vertices in each K_n fiber. A 3-coloring of C_m with three disjoint two-label sets attains 2m. Equality forces two vertices per fiber and no inter-fiber edge because each selected vertex already has within-fiber degree one. This is precisely a graph homomorphism C_m to KG(n,2). The incidence identity A=J+I-F^TF and FF^T=(n-2)I+J give eigenvalues binom(n-2,2),3-n,1 with multiplicities 1,n-1,n(n-3)/2. Therefore the trace of A^m gives N=binom(n-2,2)^m+(n-1)(3-n)^m+n(n-3)/2; there is no independence assumption or unproved infinite extrapolation. Direct independent closed-walk dynamic programming reproduced N(3,6)=90,N(4,6)=1710,N(3,7)=630,N(4,7)=11550. The n>=6 boundary is essential to the three disjoint pair construction.
